name: Pizzapocalypse 20XX
source:
A retrofuture visual novel, mashing high fantasy with modern subculture. You are Alana Sorayama, codename Neon Berserker. A bounty hunter by trade, you are about to confront an evil Glam Necromancer and his nefarious scheme to destroy all pizza in the world! 

[From [url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-27/?action=preview&uid=26423]Ludum Dare[/url]]

Created for [url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-27/]Ludum Dare 27[/url].
translation:
一部融合高奇幻与现代亚文化的复古未来主义视觉小说。你是阿拉娜·索拉亚马，代号“霓虹狂战士”，以赏金猎人为业。如今，你即将面对邪恶的华丽死灵法师，阻止他那摧毁世上所有披萨的恶毒阴谋！

［摘自[url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-27/?action=preview&uid=26423]Ludum Dare[/url]］
